producer_workspace_discrepancy.released_source_behavior: self_improve_step.py gathers the chosen parent's patch chain but skips applying it to /dgm/ when run_baseline is no_selfimprove. Diagnosis still receives the selected parent and patch_files. The implementation runs /dgm/coding_agent.py with --git_dir /dgm/, then appends the new patch to the parent's chain for evaluation. Thus the branch changes both the producer and editable target, rather than swapping the producer on an identical evolved target.
producer_workspace_discrepancy.actual_trace: swe_dgm_noselfimprove child 20250408_005738_095636 names parent 20250407_212519_184190. The parent's saved patch adds edit_range to tools/edit.py; raw history message 3 requests that file and message 4 records an editor with only view/create/edit and an explicit statement that partial/line-range edits are unsupported. The child then develops an AST editor.
producer_workspace_discrepancy.verifier_scope: verify_baseline_workspace.py uses ast.literal_eval/ast.parse and compares the observed command enum with the parent patch; it does not execute downloaded agent code. Saved verification is PASS for this parsing/consistency check.
producer_workspace_discrepancy.limits: One observed attempt corroborates the released source behavior locally. It does not establish frequency, patch-conflict causation, the size/direction of any aggregate effect, exact correspondence of the postdated source with all historical runs, or a repaired baseline's performance. It must not be used to explain all baseline failures or invalidate the pipeline's observed gains.

analysis_code_and_limitations.mechanics: analyze_lineages.py treats resolved IDs as passes and unresolved/empty-patch IDs as observed non-successes; absent IDs remain unknown. It matches scheduled parent/entry counts, checks ancestry/archive membership, restricts task gains/losses to complete pairs, and uses score bounds for forced directions. analyze_sensitivity.py computes interval deltas; the >=57-label filter applies to pair statistics, whereas admitted maxima use all native admitted children with the initial [12,14] interval included.
load_bearing_limits: One recovered run per condition; adaptive selection, shared ancestry and stochastic task solving prevent iid/causal interpretation.
Raw accuracy combines evaluation tiers near 10, 60 and 200; main has deeper evaluation absent from these ablations. Retrospective parent metadata may include later expanded evaluation.
Declared submitted counts can exceed enumerated labels; initial common60 has two absent IDs, sphinx-doc__sphinx-7985 and sphinx-doc__sphinx-8475.

No per-attempt token/expenditure receipts or reliable elapsed-time fields. Package-reported paper estimates are roughly $22000 main versus $10000 per original ablation; equal attempt counts are not equal resources and unequal cost is not itself an identified cause.

Saved local calculation receipt reports 0.056523407001805026 seconds, 242 counted attempts, zero model calls and zero paid services, with discovery inference time unmeasured. This is not all-in discovery cost.

retrospective_pattern_and_unexecuted_pro.pattern: The evaluator retrospectively groups five owner advances as replacing an overly strong intermediate obligation by a target-sufficient operation with explicit residual control: operator rather than scalar closure; required output norm; accumulated contraction; charged uncertainty; conservation/apparatus evidence. These owner-result descriptions are read as source claims here, not newly revalidated owner science. The pattern is not a demonstrated intervention, universal premise relaxation rule, or instruction the owners must follow.
retrospective_pattern_and_unexecuted_pro.matched_conventional_controls: The report explicitly names counterexample-guided abstraction, program synthesis, variational optimization and unrestricted conventional expert reasoning. A future comparison must give G1/G0 identical unseen target snapshots, correct current source, proposals/evidence and comparable total resources, independent evaluation, and the strongest target-appropriate conventional construction. A fixed-generator cumulative-search control must retain the same accumulated target state and evidence; development, integration and failures must be priced.
retrospective_pattern_and_unexecuted_pro.unexecuted_test: Cross producer versions over matched held-out targets, proposal/evidence and budgets, keeping producer distinct from the target; validate useful unsupplied receiving capability, then a further improvement-generation step. Neither that crossed test nor second-generation transfer was run. No controlled improvement of Astra's discovery process, validated new architecture, recursive growth mechanism, acceleration or historical novelty follows.
